dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you been doing research all this time?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh yeah, you mentioned "On Fungi Communities" earlier. It looks impressive... Like the kind of article that lays the foundation for the whole discipline...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are you going to become a researcher in the future, Haniyyah? Y'know, one of those masters who creates a whole new school of thought!?

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: It's not that impressive. Researchers have been exploring these theories even before the very first Nilotpala Cup.

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: I've only added a few modest additions to the theory by combining my predecessors' trial-and-error work with my own experiences with my Fungi friends.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But your practical experience is unique.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But you're the only one who can put many of these hypotheses to the test.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's true! If we're talking about who's spent the most time with Fungi in Teyvat, we'd be at the top of the list, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Even those who know more theory than you can't match up to your real-world experience, Haniyyah!

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: That's why I want to share these insights by writing a comprehensive guidebook. If I put my all into making it the best that it can be, I can help more people live in harmony with intelligent Fungi.

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: Also, I really need to thank Souka...

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: If it weren't for her daily guidance with vocabulary and syntax, I would never have been able to take the ideas in my mind and express them on paper.

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: Besides, I still cook like I'm back in my mercenary days, so she usually handles the meals at camp.

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: But after all this time, I still don't know how I should thank her... Other than paying her as much extra Mora as possible.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Now that you mention it, you're right... She's been staying with you to help look after your Fungi friends since the first Nilotpala Cup, hasn't she?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Perhaps this isn't something that can be measured in Mora...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Could it be that Souka values something beyond money?

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: Seems that just as I'm getting to know my Fungi friends, I should also spend some time getting to know this partner of mine better...
